# GitHub Copilot

Read `AGENTS.md` first, then `docs/agent/INDEX.md` and the relevant files under `docs/agent/`.

This repo root is the MV3 extension. Shared source, two manifests (`manifests/chromium.json` vs `manifests/firefox.json`). Do not merge them. Do not break `docs/agent/INVARIANTS.md`. Run `npm test` before and after edits.
